newsitem.title: CHINA: Shenzhen Development Bank changes licence.
newsitem.headline: Shenzhen Development Bank changes licence.

text.p: The Shenzhen Development Bank Co Ltd has received a new licence from the People's Bank of China, the central bank, a bank official told Reuters from Shenzhen on Tuesday.
The new licence was a "legal person licence" unlike its previous financial business licence but meant no change in its actual operations, the official said without giving further details.
The bank said in its annual report for 1996 that it had made post-tax profits of 787.48 million yuan last year, up 80.98 percent compared with 1995.
